metadata.description: Collection of Claude Code skills for developer workflows

plugins.name: claude-md-reflect
plugins.description: Analyze chat history to identify areas for improving CLAUDE.md instruction files. Use when the user says 'reflect on CLAUDE.md', 'improve CLAUDE.md', or requests analysis of instruction files after a work session. Reviews recent conversation for misunderstandings, inconsistencies, or areas where instructions could be clearer.

plugins.name: go-formatter
plugins.description: Automatically format Go files with gofmt after Write/Edit/MultiEdit operations

plugins.name: black-formatter
plugins.description: Automatically format Python files with Black after Write/Edit/MultiEdit operations

plugins.name: uber-go-style-guide
plugins.description: Review Go code for adherence to Uber's Go Style Guide. Use when the user requests a code review of completed work, pull requests, or feature branches in Go projects.

plugins.name: gemini-cli-skill
plugins.description: Orchestrate Gemini CLI for code review, web research, and architecture analysis
